recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. The current core source satisfies the final FHIR-27148 documentation intent when read with the later URL-location and content-level decisions; no follow-up core change is needed for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-27148 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 FHIR-I change request asking for a way to prefer subscription notifications that carried just a URL versus request/response details. The approved resolution was narrower: document when just the fullUrl is sufficient and when full request/response information is useful.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit 77b1c1d6b76c2c274a8cdb6209d1b21ced96ccd1, "FHIR#27148", which expanded Subscription payload documentation. That historical text described empty, id-only, and full-resource notifications, discussed id-only resource URLs in Bundle.entry.fullUrl/request/response, and pointed to the then-current Subscription.notificationUrlLocation element for URL placement behavior.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2020-05-18 confirm the approved scope was documentation, not necessarily a new permanent preference mechanism. Later published URL-location issues in the same family are already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-36081 superseded the old placement mechanism by removing Subscription.notificationUrlLocation and making SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent.focus the fixed location for event resource references. FHIR-47353 later clarified the current Subscription.content wording and is also already represented on the combined branch. Subscription remains an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/subscription/subscription-notes.xml already explains empty, id-only, and full-resource notification content, including when clients retrieve resources by references/URLs and when full-resource notifications use entry.resource or, if the resource cannot be included, entry.request and/or entry.response. Current source/subscription/structuredefinition-Subscription.xml links Subscription.content to that Notification Content guidance. Reintroducing a preference or notificationUrlLocation wording would conflict with the later published FHIR-36081 cleanup.

related_jiras.note: Removed Subscription.notificationUrlLocation and moved event resource references to SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent.focus, superseding the old URL-location preference mechanics; already represented on the combined branch.
Requested default behavior for Subscription.notificationUrlLocation, but that element was later removed and this issue is already represented on the combined branch.
Requested examples for Subscription.notificationUrlLocation; Jira later notes the element was removed by FHIR-36081, and this issue is already represented on the combined branch.
Clarified current Subscription.content and payload-content wording, supporting the current no-change conclusion; already represented on the combined branch.
